source_title: Fiscal Q1 2023 Earnings Call Prepared Remarks
claim_relevant_visible_text: Shipment volumes were impacted by our customers’ inventory adjustments, the trajectory of their end demand, and macroeconomic uncertainty. We believe that aggregate customer inventory, while still high, is coming down in absolute volume, as end market consumption outpaces ship-in.
researcher_paraphrase: Micron stated that customer inventory remained high but was declining because end-market consumption exceeded ship-in, directly exposing de-stocking as a gap between consumption and procurement.
precision_guard: This is a December 2022 management statement about aggregate customer inventory and ship-in versus end-market consumption. It does not identify individual customer inventories or prove prior double ordering.
authority_boundary: Micron is primary for its own management statement and observations, not an audited inventory ledger for all customers.
